activity.notes: Hacı I Giray founded the Crimean Khanate and established the Giray dynasty. Genoese evidence and coinage make 1441 a common foundation/accession date, but modern scholarship also uses alternative dates including 1449, so ATLAS marks the start approximate. Some king lists insert a brief and uncertain displacement by his son Hayder in 1456; because the interruption itself is disputed, ATLAS preserves one representative founder-khan interval to Hacı's death in August 1466 rather than asserting a precise split reign.

sources.citation_text: The biography summarizes Genoese and numismatic evidence for Hacı I Giray as founder of the Crimean Khanate, commonly dated from 1441, and records his death in August 1466 while noting competing accession chronologies.
